feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 10 June 2026 11:14am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 10 June 2026 at 11:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the south of Iceland driving a frontal zone across the British Isles tomorrow.


##Wind##

West or southwest 3 or 4, backing south or southwest 4 or 5 overnight, increasing 5 or 6 tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight, building mainly moderate tomorrow morning.


##Weather##

Occasional showers soon becoming isolated. Rain or drizzle approaching from the west later.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, then becoming moderate or poor in rain or drizzle later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 4 or 5, but southerly 5 or 6 in the east to start, veering west or southwest 5 or 6 in all waters Thursday evening/night, decreasing 4 or 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, soon becoming slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Rain or drizzle becoming isolated.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or drizzle.
